description:
## What

End-to-end test demonstrating that a chain missing an intermediate validates via the AiaFetcher seam.

## Fixture

Build (or reuse) a 3-cert chain where the leaf points to a sub-CA via AIA URL, and the test only provides the leaf + root in the caller-supplied chain (intermediate is missing). The AiaFetcher must fetch the intermediate, path-build must complete, validation must succeed.

## Test approach

1. Generate (or use existing) a leaf + sub-CA + root chain. Leaf has AIA extension with `caIssuers` = `http://localhost:<port>/intermediate.cer`.
2. Spawn a localhost HTTP mock server (use `hyper` test infra or similar) that serves the intermediate cert at that URL.
3. Construct `pkix_aia_http::HttpFetcher` pointed at the mock server.
4. Call `pkix_chain::verify_chain(&[leaf, root], &anchors, &policy, &verifier, &NoRevocation, &http_fetcher)`.
5. Assert: validation succeeds, returned `ValidatedPath::depth == 2`, leaf identity matches.

Negative tests:
6. Same setup but use `NoAiaFetcher`: validation fails with `Error::AiaFetchFailed` (or `AiaChainBuildFailed`).
7. Same setup but mock server returns 404: validation fails with `AiaError::HttpStatus(404)`.
8. Same setup but AIA URI is `ldap://...`: HttpFetcher returns `AiaError::UriUnsupported`; validation fails.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Test file `pkix-difftest/tests/aia_fetcher_e2e.rs` or `pkix-chain/tests/aia_e2e.rs`
- [ ] Positive case passes
- [ ] All 3 negative cases pass
- [ ] Fixture committed under appropriate `tests/fixtures/` directory
- [ ] No real network access (localhost mock server only)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry on whichever crate hosts the test

## Out of scope

- Recursive AIA fetch test (intermediate has its own missing issuer) — file as follow-up if needed
- Differential test against OpenSSL `verify -CAfile` with AIA chasing — OpenSSL CLI does AIA chasing differently; potential follow-up

## Cross-references

- PKIX-zkjb (parent)
- PKIX-zkjb.5 (pkix-aia-http, needed for HttpFetcher)
- PKIX-zkjb.7 (verify_chain integration, needed to wire AiaFetcher through)
notes: [2026-05-13 do-beads loop escalation] PKIX-zkjb.8 (differential test of AIA fetching) is gated on .5 (pkix-aia-http adapter), .6 (verify_chain integration), and the upstream chain (.2 AiaError, .3 AiaFetcher, .4 NoAiaFetcher) — none of which currently exist (pkix-aia crate does not exist; no AiaFetcher trait defined yet). bd shows zkjb.8 as 'ready' because the bd dep graph wiring on PKIX-zkjb's children appears inverted (see PKIX-zkjb.4 human-label comment for full analysis and recommended re-wiring). Loop moves on; .8 will surface naturally after .5 and .6 close, once the dep graph is corrected.
title: Differential test: missing-intermediate fixture validates with AiaFetcher
